claims.statement: For every real matrix M, physical row i, physical column a and k>=1, H_{k+1}^{i,a}(M) >= (T_k(M)/k) H_k^{i,a}(M), where H_k is the sum of squared k-minors containing both anchors and T_k is squared Frobenius distance to rank <=k. Constant 1/k is sharp.

On the designated-partner incident branch H3>omega F^6, T2>=theta F^2 and after D5 fails, with epsilon3=theta/225: either H4<=(epsilon3/3)H3F^2 and T3<=epsilon3F^2, or H4>(epsilon3/3)H3F^2 and T4<12 eta_*/(epsilon3 omega) F^2.

In the low-H4 branch, if either top-three physical singular projection has all diagonal leverages <=1/2, the c2414 PEER_TAIL_EXTENSION applies because s4/sqrt(T2)<=1/15. The full ambient density is continuous and obeys the displayed universal cap (<37634 at theta=1/16, kappa=1/(256sqrt3), Lambda=1).

A high anchored H4 bank either stops at one of three explicit residual 2/3-conditional-diffuse levels, or after three concentration failures contains a physical 4x4 minor of squared determinant >H4/27.

In N3(tau), the terminal 4x4 minor gives an <=8-coordinate actual symmetric principal block with three absolute eigenvalues bounded below by (H4/27)^(1/4)/(4sqrt(tau+tau^2)); finite-dimensional conditioning gives an essentially bounded density. Continuity is not claimed for this receiver.

Pay either the low-H4 rank-three tube when both top-three physical frames have leverage >1/2, or the high-H4 conditional-diffuse anchored-fourth-volume packets while preserving arbitrary same-bank curvature and the actual nonzero rank-four tail.
